directive: Deity Raids are multi-stage solo-divine mastery gauntlets: one active deity crossing an unstable Gate alone.

standardStructure.name: Elite Interdiction
standardStructure.goal: Defeat protected elites or break ritual guards.

standardStructure.name: Boss Revelation
standardStructure.goal: Fight first boss phase and learn core mechanic.

standardStructure.name: Realm Collapse
standardStructure.goal: Battlefield changes; hazards, routes, and objectives mutate.

standardStructure.name: Divine Confrontation
standardStructure.goal: Final boss phase / enemy deity Ascension duel.

difficultyTiers.mechanics: additional elite mechanics and tighter hazard timing
extra stage modifier, stronger AI, altered boss pattern
Divinity denial windows, battlefield mutation, stricter scoring
maximum phase complexity, leaderboard scoring, optional challenge seals

scalingModel.overlevelRule: older raid tiers remain conquerable; player progression must be visible
scalingModel.endgameRule: top tiers flex inside explicit power bands and score mastery rather than infinite gear checks

bossPhaseRules: Each phase introduces or twists a mechanic
Enrage is pressure, not a hidden timer kill
replayability: weekly rotation of raid boss variants

rewardDesign.nonPayToWin: Raid power is earned through play, not required spend.
rewardDesign.badLuckProtection: weekly raid tokens can target missing set pieces without trivializing rare drops

sampleRaids.name: The Gate Warden
sampleRaids.coreMechanic: Seal pillars expose and hide the boss weakness while hazard lanes divide the battlefield.
sampleRaids.finalPhase: Warden opens a collapsing Gate and challenges the deity to survive Divine backlash.

sampleRaids.name: The Hollow Crown
sampleRaids.coreMechanic: Swarmers feed a crown meter unless executed in correct terrain zones.
sampleRaids.finalPhase: Enemy champion wears the Crown and becomes an anti-Divinity duelist.

sampleRaids.name: The Drowned Sun Colossus
sampleRaids.coreMechanic: Water and light zones alternate, empowering different deity builds.
sampleRaids.finalPhase: Boss drains the arena, creating high-risk execution lanes.

implementationNotes: Raid state remains deterministic and UI-independent
Each stage serializes separately for resume/replay
Rewards resolve after validated victory lock
Leaderboard scoring records turn count, damage taken, executions, objectives, and modifiers
